headline: If your newborn will only sleep on your chest
body: You didn't teach them to need this.
For nine months, your heartbeat, movement, warmth, and voice were part of their world.

So when they fall asleep on your chest, they're not "learning bad habits."
/They're finding something familiar./

And yes, a contact nap is still a nap.
/You don't have to make every sleep look independent./
One day, they'll fall asleep somewhere else.
For now, you get to be the place they know.
